changelog:
Initial release of the sales-enablement skill, focused on creating high-impact collateral for sales teams.

- Provides detailed frameworks and best practices for pitch decks, one-pagers, objection handling docs, ROI calculators, and demo scripts.
- Emphasizes customization to deal stage, persona, and specific rep needs.
- Includes guidance on collaborating with sales for trusted, usable assets.
- Offers templates, structural breakdowns, and practical design principles for real-world B2B sales enablement.
